title: Electrically-Small Rydberg Sensor for Three-Dimensional Determination of RF k-Vectors
abstract: Army Research Lab demonstration of complete three-dimensional vector polarimetry with a Rydberg-atom RF electrometer. Shows k-vector direction determination using a single electrically-small vapor cell sensor. Extends ARL Rydberg sensor program (Meyer, Cox, Kunz) to full 3D spatial field characterization.
key_claims: Single vapor cell determines 3D direction of incoming RF wavevector
Electrically small sensor (sub-wavelength) achieves full angle-of-arrival recovery
Extends previous ARL broadband Rydberg sensor work to spatial sensing
Relevant to direction-finding and spectrum awareness applications
